google.1: Open the Google Cloud Console and pick (or create) a project.
google.2: Go to APIs & Services → Library and enable the "Google Picker API".
google.3: Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID, type "Web application". Paste the redirect URI below into "Authorized redirect URIs", then copy the client ID and secret.
google.4: Credentials → Create credentials → API key, and copy it into the Picker API key field.
google.5: On the OAuth consent screen, add your own Google account under Test users (while the app is in Testing mode).

notion.2: On the Configuration tab choose type "Public" and fill in the required details.
notion.3: Paste the redirect URI below into "Redirect URIs", then copy the OAuth client ID and secret.
notion.4: Save here, then click "Connect" — Notion will ask which pages to share.

keyRotation.title: How Key Rotation Works
rules: System selects the key with fewest requests (round-robin)
If 429 error (rate limit) occurs, automatically switches to next key
If 429 error on a model, automatically falls back: gemini-2.5-flash → gemini-2.5-flash-lite → gemini-2.0-flash
Keys with 401/403 errors are marked as inactive
All keys share the same pool — more keys = higher throughput
